checks.name: Fresh player enters setup on the offline Play with bots action
Shift+Tab from the first select wraps to the last visible setup control
Tab from the last visible setup control wraps to the first select
Controller down skips collapsed online fields and wraps to the first visible control
Controller up wraps to the visible online summary, not its hidden fields
Expanded online fields remain inside the same focus boundary
Expanded setup wraps forward to the first select
Tab within an editable name field keeps its ordinary next-control behavior
Escape from an input exits setup, restores menu focus and clears the private key

limitations: Headless Chromium synthetic keyboard events in a fresh profile; no physical-device acceptance.
